newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SOUTHGATE DEAL TO STAY AT VILLA UNTIL 2001.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTHGATE DEAL TO STAY AT VILLA UNTIL 2001.

text.p: Aston Villa's England defender Gareth Southgate has agreed a new contract that will keep him at the English premier league club until 2001.
Southgate, who joined Villa in a 2.5 million pounds ($4.1 million) transfer from Crystal Palace in mid-1995, has signed a new four-and-a-half year deal.

Villa manager Brian Little said: Gareth is one of a group of players who are very much part of Villa's future. The new deal is testimony to everything that he has achieved at the club since joining us."
